verdict.rationale: Composio documents parallel tool execution across apps via meta-tools and a dedicated remote sandbox (COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH) explicitly for 'bulk operations or processing large tool responses', supporting bulk-style automation. However there's no concrete example, benchmark, or hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk operations (e.g., batch processing hundreds of items) actually working end-to-end. missing for 10: worked examples of bulk/batch operations at scale, independent corroboration, quantitative limits or performance details.
